about.title: About Adi Shakti Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni Mandir
about.subtitle: A sanctuary of devotion, peace, and maternal grace in the holy pilgrim town of Titwala.
about.p1: Adi Shakti Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni Mandir in Titwala, Maharashtra, is a sacred place dedicated to the Divine Mother. Devotees visit the Mandir to offer prayers, seek Maa's blessings, and find spiritual comfort, courage, and inner peace.
about.p2: Inspired by the eternal power of Adi Shakti, the Mandir brings devotees together through faith, worship, seva, and festivals. From daily Darshan to the vibrant celebrations of Navratri, every occasion offers an opportunity to deepen devotion and experience the spirit of togetherness.
about.p3: May Maa Bhavtarni bless every devotee with strength, wisdom, happiness, and prosperity.
about.pillar1Desc: Daily prayers, sacred Aarti, and continuous chanting creating an atmosphere of deep tranquility and spiritual upliftment.
about.pillar2Desc: Welcoming pilgrims from across Maharashtra and India with devotion, Prasad distribution, and community support.
about.pillar3Desc: Preserving authentic Vedic rites, vibrant Navratri celebrations, and devotional Chowki events for spiritual growth.

devotional.quote: “Where there is faith in Maa, there is courage to face every challenge. May Maa Bhavtarni guide us towards peace, compassion, and righteousness.”
devotional.author: Adi Shakti Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni Mandir • Titwala

kartik-purnima-deepotsav.name: Kartik Purnima Mahapooja & 1008 Deepotsav
kartik-purnima-deepotsav.description: Auspicious Dev Diwali celebrations featuring special Shringar of Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni, 1008 pure cow ghee earthen lamps illumination, Maha Aarti, and distribution of Kheer Prasad.

divya-mata-ki-chowki.name: Divya Mata Ki Chowki & Akhand Bhajan Sandhya
divya-mata-ki-chowki.description: Soul-stirring devotional bhajans by renowned bhajan mandalis, Akhand Jyot Darshan, floral offerings at Maa's lotus feet, Ardaas prayer, and 56 Bhog Mahaprasad.

magh-gupt-navratri.name: Magha Gupt Navratri Mahotsav
magh-gupt-navratri.description: Sacred period for internal spiritual sadhana, Durga Saptashati parayan, Hawan, and special evening aartis seeking divine protection and strength.

maha-shivratri.name: Maha Shivratri Mahotsav & Akhand Rudrabhishek
maha-shivratri.timings: All-Night 4-Prahar Pujan (6:00 AM – Next Morning 6:00 AM)
maha-shivratri.description: Auspicious Shiva-Shakti union celebration featuring continuous Vedic Rudrabhishek, 1008 Bilvapatra archana, milk & honey panchamrit abhishek, and devotional Shiv-Durga aarti.

temple-sthapna.name: Annual Mandir Sthapna Diwas & Patotsav
temple-sthapna.description: Commemorating the holy Pran Pratishtha of Adi Shakti Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni with 108 Kalash Pujan, Maha Yagya, Flag hoisting (Dhwajarohan), and Community Mahaprasad for all devotees.

hanuman-jayanti-sundarkand.name: Hanuman Jayanti & Sangeetmay Sundarkand Path
hanuman-jayanti-sundarkand.description: Celebration of Shri Hanuman Janmotsav with musical recitation of Shri Sundarkand, sacred Sindoor chola offering, 108 Hanuman Chalisa chanting, and Boondi Mahaprasad distribution.

chaitra-navratri.name: Chaitra Navratri Mahotsav & Ram Navami
chaitra-navratri.description: Nine sacred days of devotion featuring Ghatasthapana, Akhand Jyot, daily Chandi Path, special floral shringar of Maa Bhavtarni, and grand Kanya Pujan on Ram Navami.

weekly-sankirtan.name: Weekly Tuesday & Saturday Maa Ki Aarti & Kirtan
weekly-sankirtan.description: Weekly community devotional gathering where devotees join in traditional dholak, chimta, and harmonium accompanied bhajan kirtan followed by Halwa and Chana prasad.

vasant-panchami.name: Vasant Panchami & Saraswati Devi Avahan
vasant-panchami.description: Welcoming the auspicious spring season with yellow floral shringar of Maa Vaishno, Saraswati Pujan, book and pen blessings for students, and sweet saffron Kesari prasad.

guru-purnima-paduka.name: Guru Purnima & Sacred Charan Paduka Archana
guru-purnima-paduka.description: Special day of gratitude dedicated to the divine lineage and Charan Paduka worship. Devotees offer Panchamrit snan, sandalwood paste, and fragrant flower garlands at Maa's holy lotus feet.

sharad-purnima-kheer.name: Kojagiri (Sharad) Purnima Amrit Kheer Utsav
sharad-purnima-kheer.description: Sacred Kojagiri night celebrations with moonlight bhajan sandhya, Lakshmi-Vaishno pujan, and distribution of saffron-cardamom Amrit Kheer kept under the nectar-raining full moon.

sharad-navratri.name: Sharad Navratri Mahotsav
sharad-navratri.description: The most magnificent autumn festival at the temple with 9 days of royal poshak shringar, Tridevi Mahapooja, Dandiya Raas, and thousands of devotees seeking Maa's blessings.

vijayadashami.name: Vijayadashami / Dussehra Utsav
vijayadashami.description: Commemorating the victory of Maa Durga over Mahishasura and righteousness over unrighteousness. Featuring Shastra Pujan, Aparajita Pujan, and distribution of holy Prasad.

home.aboutTitle: About Adi Shakti Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni Mandir
home.aboutP1: Situated in the sacred town of Titwala, Maharashtra, Adi Shakti Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni Mandir is a sanctified shrine dedicated to the Divine Mother. Devotees visit this sacred abode to seek Maa's eternal blessings, strength, and inner spiritual peace.
home.aboutP2: Inspired by the eternal power of Adi Shakti, the Mandir enshrines the holy Tridevi (Maa Mahakali, Maa Mahalakshmi, Maa Mahasaraswati) alongside the sacred Charan Paduka, uniting thousands of devotees through daily worship, Vedic rituals, and festival celebrations.
home.gallerySubtitle: Glimpses of the sanctum sanctorum, golden shringar, and holy Charan Paduka.
home.exploreGallery: Explore Full Photo Gallery & Mandir Video
home.sevaDesc: Contribute towards daily worship, flower shringar, Navratri Mahotsav arrangements, and ongoing temple development. Every donation directly supports the holy abode.
home.shlokaMeaning: “O Divine Mother, the auspiciousness of all that is auspicious, the fulfiller of every blessing, the protector of the devoted — we bow to You with deepest reverence.”
home.pilgrimSubtitle: Located conveniently near Titwala Railway Station on the Central Railway route.
home.templeAddress: Adi Shakti Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni Mandir, Titwala, Taluka Kalyan, District Thane, Maharashtra - 421605, India
home.transportDesc: Titwala is accessible from Mumbai CST / Thane via Central Railway suburban trains. Auto-rickshaws are readily available from Titwala railway station to the temple.
home.sevaBoxDesc: Your generous contribution directly supports the daily worship, flower shringar, Prasad bhandara, and festival arrangements of Maa's Darbar. Every donation is an offering of faith and seva.
home.shloka: ॥ ॐ सर्वमंगल मांगल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थ साधिके । शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥

guidelines.title: Sacred Rules & Darshan Etiquette
guidelines.subtitle: Please adhere to these devotional guidelines during your pilgrimage to preserve the sanctity of Maa's Darbar.
guidelines.item1Desc: Devotees are welcome to participate in Morning Aarti (7:30 AM) and Sandhya Aarti (7:00 PM). Please maintain silence and sanctity during prayers.
guidelines.item2Desc: Please deposit footwear at the designated shoe stand near the temple entrance before entering the sacred sanctum.
guidelines.item3Desc: Fresh flowers, chunri, coconut, and satvik sweets can be offered to Maa. Sacred Prasad is distributed daily after Aarti.
guidelines.item4Desc: Photography is permitted in the temple courtyard. Devotees are kindly requested to maintain sanctity and refrain from flash photography in the sanctum.
